card.name: Small words just before a key phrase
card.fires_on: Short linking words, opening quote marks or a possessive 's in general prose, right before a defining noun or title is named. Examples are 'is to', 'is "', 'the same' and 'or shape'.

modes.label: Linking word before a definition
modes.description: A small word like to, is, the, same or or that leads into a stated goal, identity or definition.
modes.example: Our ultimate vocation is<< to>> heaven.

modes.label: Opening quote before a title or slogan
modes.description: An opening quotation mark that introduces a quoted phrase, slogan or description.
modes.example: The Second United Nations Global Road Safety Week (6–12 May) kicks off worldwide under the banner<< “>>Make Walking Safe”
